Organic farming

Sustainable Farming & Quality Food Supply

Building a Food-Secure World: The world’s population is growing fast—and so is the need for food. Today, over 700 million people face hunger every day, while 2 billion people lack access to enough safe, nutritious food.

As the food and agriculture division of Qaranda Industries Ltd., we work with farmers, suppliers, and partners to produce more food with less environmental impact—bringing quality produce from farms to store shelves and family tables across the globe.

Order Fresh ProduceView Our Farms

Core pillars

01

Agribusiness & Farm Operations

Qaranda Industries operates agricultural farmland, grows natural crops, and supplies fresh produce directly to markets and buyers.

02

Environmental Protection & Reforestation

We are deeply committed to protecting the environment by actively planting more trees, preserving soil health, and practicing sustainable land management.

03

Tech-Enabled Agriculture (Smart Farming)

Leveraging modern technology, cloud monitoring, and data-driven systems to maximize food sustainability, optimize yield, and boost agricultural efficiency.

Growing with local farmers

In both Uganda and the DRC, our agribusiness works with local farmers. Together we grow and supply fresh produce to markets and buyers, and we aim to build lasting partnerships in the communities where we operate.

Qaranda Capital & Market Analytics

Systematic Execution, Quantitative Risk Management & Global Liquidity

At Qaranda Capital, we engage global financial markets through structured analysis, disciplined execution, and strict risk parameters. Just as we protect assets across our agribusiness and technology operations, our capital management enforces unwavering risk discipline to ensure long-term stability and growth.
